article_1.title: The BIG ET
article_1.description: The big ET is a humanoid entity that wanders around human living areas at night. It typically takes a liking to quiet and dark environments
traits: The BIG ET is a shy entity that is easily stressed out by human gaze
it emitts a small radioactive field around it, however this should not cause damage unless you were within it's 1 meter radius
The BIG ET has an alien like appearance
It makes a loud screeching voice when inspected and launches itself towards the witness to murder them.
article_1.recommended_action: If you have encountered the BIG ET, try to ignore it. If not and the BIG ET has noticed you looking at it. We recommend the HSH body searching service! If the BIG ET is wandering in your neighbourhood, do not worry, it will leave within 5-7 days as long as you don't look at it.

article_2.title: ybrik
article_2.description: ybrik is a round, red sphere with cartoon eyes with two hands and two feet.
traits: Ybrik is always irritated, which is why it always is red
Ybrik loves chilli
Ybrik makes a 'yopo' sound when near by
Makes loud thumping footsteps when passing by
article_2.recommended_action: If the human has possibly encountered ybrik, ABORT MISSION Please use the HSH emergency exit service.

article_3.title: Cockroaches
article_3.description: Cockroaches are small, oval-shaped insects that commonly live in warm, dark, and damp areas. They are usually active at night and may hide behind appliances, inside cupboards, under sinks, or within cracks and wall spaces.
traits: When you find one, there's always already a group of it
Small, brown droppings
Musty smell
Quiet rustling at night
article_3.recommended_action: Please use the HSH insect removal service :D

article_4.title: Wind Sprouts
article_4.description: The wind sprouts are a light weighted seed that is easily carried by wind. A wind sprout hoarde can be seen from a 100 meter radius. If observed, please run immediately.
traits: The wind sprouts can attatch onto your skin and grow roots. This can cause:
Wind sprout infection
New seeds possibly growing inside your blood vessels. If let on, can cause your body to shut down.
article_4.recommended_action: Run immediately until wind sprout hoarde is no longer visible. If the wind sprouts are within 10 meter radius, use the HSH exterminate service.

article_5.title: Telephone Bug
article_5.description: The telephone bug is a form of parasite that inserts itself into hand held telephones. It typically manifests as small feet dangling off the speaker of traditional hand held telephones
traits: Little foot and antennas dangling out of the speaker of the telephone
Little chipping sound can be heard
It leaves a sticky trail of footsteps on the handle of the telephone
Likes cold environments
article_5.recommended_action: Do NOT use the telephone, the telephone bug will take that oppertunity to enter your ear and live there. However, if that has already happened, please call the HSH medical department for an ear removal service.

article_6.title: Boris
article_6.description: Boris is a pigeon like creature that flies around schools
traits: Grey body with darker wings, with a ring of white feather at the bottom of the neck
Small head with a short beak.
An intense stare
It may leave grey feathers and may hear bird chipping sound when near it
article_6.recommended_action: Do not feed Boris or let him near you. If he comes close, don't fight back and use the HSH cremation service.

article_7.title: Laser Kiwi
article_7.description: A normal appearing bird with two legs and wings although they cannot fly. However, the Laser Kiwis have green eyes. The Laser Kiwis can be met in the wild at night. There is a small chance it will wander into your home if your house has wooden flooring. The encounters might report damaged flooring, unknown green light or presence of wet bird footprints.
traits: Glowing Green eyes
Leavs footprints like birds, with three short claws
Usually appears in the woods at night
The area where the laser Kiwi is located will be dead silent aside from laser kiwi activity
article_7.recommended_action: Move away from the observed laser kiwi immediately as quietly as possible.

article_8.title: Mad Cow
article_8.description: The mad cow appears like any ordinary cows you can find. With 4 legs and 4 hooves, 2 horns and a tail. The pattern on fur varies depending on cow species
traits: The caller may encounter one or multiple cows staring at them.
Loss of direction
Loud wind in the area where the Mad Cows are located
The mam cows have a full set of 72 teeths in total
article_8.recommended_action: Stare back at the cow and continue to move, if the cow starts to eat grass, you are now safe. If now, please use the HSH cremation service.

article_9.title: Seals
article_9.description: Seals are fat blubberous creatures that lives on the shore, near the ocean. They typically appear grey with round eyes, two flippers and a tail being a powerful rear flipper
traits: Seals make an ououououou sound when near by
Loud wind at their natural habitat, however they do go out into the wild
They flop when they are on land as their bodies are built to swim
Friendly
article_9.recommended_action: Don't leave. Seals are friendly creatures :D

article_10.title: THE Job Application
article_10.description: THE job application is a moving piece of paper that wonders around after being created.
traits: Callers that report THE job application may report flapping paper sound.
The caller may recently quit their job and/or being jobless.
article_10.recommended_action: If you have a job, do not quit it. If you are quitting your job, ensure there are no job applications near your current area.
